outputs.vsdr: Share of voiced speech in total speech, VSDR (-)
outputs.ste: Speech timing entropy from the proportions of the four classes, STE (bit)
outputs.ssr_change: Change in the number of speech segments per minute, last third of the recording minus the first, ΔSSR (seg/min)

min_segments.description: Minimum number of segments for the rate change (ssr_change) to be computed
